newsitem.title: CANADA: Canadian dollar opens firmer, seen range-bound.
newsitem.headline: Canadian dollar opens firmer, seen range-bound.

text.p: * The Canadian dollar firmed in quiet overnight trading from Tuesday's North American close but the move did not spur a great deal of interest from investors, analysts said.
* Strength in February retail sales prompted buy-back interest. * Trading should occur in a narrow range today, with players eyeing Canada's 30-year bond auction.
Canada's currency was seen steady on Wednesday after strong overseas buying, mired in a range of C$1.3910 to C$1.3950, one foreign exchange trader said.
On the crosses, the Canadian dollar slipped to 1.2296 marks from Tuesday's close of 1.2301 and dipped to 90.46 yen from 90.49.
